about: Results that depend only on the emulated CPU, from 86Box fff297459 (upstream master, 2026-10-17). Synthetic CPU 3D Speed stayed within 0.2 % over 11 runs, across 1, 2 and 4 Voodoo render threads, the Voodoo recompiler on and off, and one host CPU or many. The Voodoo-bound results (the games, fill rate, bump mapping, the overall score) are not here: they follow how fast the host renders (see README.md).
